run_knn_evaluation_cli: run the DINOv2 k-NN evaluation CLI with default ImageNet train and validation datasets
run_knn_with_custom_k: run k-NN evaluation with custom neighbor counts like 5 10 50 using the CLI
run_knn_gather_on_cpu: run k-NN evaluation gathering train features on CPU to avoid OOM on large datasets
eval_knn_with_model: evaluate a DINOv2 model using k-NN classification on ImageNet with configurable k values and temperature
create_KnnModule: create a KnnModule to compute k-nearest neighbors across distributed processes for feature classification
